questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to the park yesterday.

questions.def: 'am going to' is used for future plans.
questions.question: I ___ a new car next year.

questions.def: With 'he', the correct form is 'doesn't'.
questions.question: He don't like to eat vegetables.

questions.def: Use the present simple tense for regular actions.
questions.question: She ___ in a hospital.

questions.def: Use the comparative form '-er' for short adjectives.
questions.question: He is ___ than his brother.

questions.def: Past continuous describes ongoing actions in the past.
questions.question: They ___ TV when I arrived.

questions.def: 'Made' is the past simple form of 'make'.
questions.question: I ___ a cake yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'an' before words that start with a vowel sound.
questions.question: There is ___ apple on the table.

questions.def: Use 'were' in the second conditional.
questions.question: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.

questions.def: Use the present perfect tense 'have eaten'.
questions.question: They ___ dinner already.

questions.def: 'Best' is the superlative of 'good'.
questions.question: This is the ___ movie I have ever seen.

questions.def: Use 'if' to introduce a yes/no question.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I liked coffee.

questions.def: Use present perfect to indicate duration that started in the past.
questions.question: He ___ here for five years.

questions.def: Use 'a' before singular countable nouns starting with a consonant sound.
questions.question: She is ___ student in the class.

questions.def: Use 'to' before the infinitive form of the verb.
questions.question: They told me ___ come early.

questions.def: Past simple of 'go' is 'went'.
questions.question: I ___ to the cinema last night.

questions.def: 'I' uses the verb 'have'.
questions.question: I ___ a lot of friends.

questions.def: 'That' is used to introduce a reported statement.
questions.question: She said ___ she was tired.

questions.def: 'I' uses the verb 'want' in present simple.
questions.question: I ___ to go home.

questions.def: Use 'an' before a vowel sound.
questions.question: This is ___ interesting book.

questions.def: 'are coming' is present continuous (future arrangement).
questions.question: They are ___ to the party.

questions.def: 'He' takes the verb 'is'.
questions.question: He ___ a doctor.

questions.def: 'Little' refers to uncountable nouns like money.
questions.question: I have ___ money left.

questions.def: Use 'will + base form' for future conditional (type 1).
questions.question: They ___ to the beach if it doesn't rain.

questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions in the past.
questions.question: They ___ to the cinema last night.

questions.def: The past simple form of 'buy' is 'bought'.
questions.question: He ___ a new car last week.

questions.def: 'She' requires 'doesn't' instead of 'don't'.
questions.question: She don't like to eat fish.

questions.def: Use present perfect for actions started in the past.
questions.question: He ___ in London for five years.

questions.def: Use the past simple tense for completed actions.
questions.question: I ___ to the store yesterday.

questions.def: Use the base form with 'they' in the present simple.
questions.question: They ___ tennis every Sunday morning.
